description: Parse reference HTML (e.g. a Google Stitch / Figma / Codex export) into a structural blueprint (title, headings, paragraphs, images, buttons, colour palette) you can rebuild as native BuilderX sections with new_section. Not a 1:1 clone. Rebuild every part native elements can do; use an embed only for a piece no element can (third-party widget, custom animation) — never paste the whole HTML into one (sandboxed iframe: no SEO, broken links, dead forms; rejected on save).
name: ingest_html
